subject: pathology
title: Pituitary and adrenal pathology: adenomas, Cushing, Conn and phaeochromocytoma

steps.tx: **Pituitary neuroendocrine tumours** (PitNETs, benign, sellar expansion with **bitemporal hemianopia** from chiasm compression) sort by stain and hormone: **prolactinoma** (commonest, galactorrhoea with amenorrhoea, stalk effect hyperprolactinaemia, **dopamine agonists** cabergoline shrinking), GH somatotroph (acromegaly), ACTH corticotroph (Cushing disease), TSH and gonadotroph (usually nonfunctioning presenting with mass effect). **Transsphenoidal resection** cures most except prolactinomas; apoplexy (sudden headache with visual loss into adenoma) needs urgent steroids with decompression.
steps.say: Milky amenorrhoea with stalk mass is prolactinoma: dopamine agonist shrinks. Bitemporal loss is chiasm squeezed: resect sphenoidally.

steps.tx: **Acromegaly** (GH excess, coarse facies with prognathism, sweaty doughy hands, carpal tunnel, cardiomyopathy with diabetes, colon polyps) is confirmed by **failed OGTT suppression** with high IGF-1; treatment is transsphenoidal surgery with **octreotide** or pegvisomant and radiotherapy backup. **Cushing disease** (pituitary ACTH, central obesity with striae, hypertension, glucose intolerance) is separated from ectopic (small cell lung, high ACTH with hypokalaemia) and adrenal (low ACTH) by **high dose dexamethasone suppression** with petrosal sampling; selective adenomectomy cures.
steps.say: Big jaw sweaty hands unsuppressed on glucose are acromegaly: operate, octreotide. Pituitary Cushing suppresses on high dose dexamethasone.

steps.tx: **Pituitary apoplexy** (haemorrhage into adenoma, thunderclap headache with ophthalmoplegia and visual loss, adrenal crisis) is resuscitated with **stress steroids** then urgent decompression; Sheehan (postpartum necrosis with agalactia) and empty sella mimic functionally. **Craniopharyngioma** (Rathke pouch, **adamantinomatous** calcified cystic in children versus papillary **BRAF** adults, bitemporal loss with short stature and DI) is resected conservatively (hypothalamic obesity threatens) with radiotherapy backup. Hypothalamic hamartoma (gelastic seizures with precocity) differs.
steps.say: Thunderclap blind into adenoma is apoplexy: steroids then decompress. Calcified cystic child with short stature is craniopharyngioma.

steps.tx: **Adrenal cortex** lesions sort by hormone: **Conn aldosteronoma** (hypertension with **hypokalaemia** and metabolic alkalosis, low renin high aldosterone ratio, adrenal vein sampling lateralises, spironolactone bridges to adrenalectomy), Cushing adenoma (low ACTH, laparoscopic removal), **adrenocortical carcinoma** (**Weiss criteria**, large necrotic heterogeneous masses, **mitotane** with EDP chemotherapy). **Phaeochromocytoma** (medulla, **10 percent rule**: bilateral, malignant, extra adrenal, familial MEN2 and VHL, **paroxysmal hypertension** with headache sweats palpitations, **metanephrines** raised) needs **alpha blockade first** (phenoxybenzamine) then surgery; unblocked beta blockade kills. **Incidentaloma** workup (1 mg dexamethasone, aldosterone renin, metanephrines) sorts.
steps.say: Hypokalaemic hypertensive low renin is Conn: vein sample, remove. Paroxysmal triad with metanephrines is phaeo: alpha first.
